links.outcome: Unscheduled hospital visits for chemotherapy toxicity within 12 weeks, chatbot vs usual care
links.effect: Unscheduled visits 15% (3/20) chatbot vs 35% (7/20) usual care (P=.24, not significant). Quality-of-life fatigue (P=.02), global health (P=.04) and physical functioning (P=.04) favored chatbot.
links.quote: Unscheduled hospital visits occurred in 15% (3/20) of the chatbot group compared to 35% (7/20) of the usual care group (P=.24).

screen.reason: Pilot randomized controlled trial evaluating the deployment of a mobile chatbot for supportive cancer care versus usual care, but not testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
